instruction: Studio portrait photograph, medium shot. Against a solid light blue background, three women hug. On the left, the Asian woman in a beige tank top (R1) smiles towards the center, placing her hand on the shoulder of the curly-haired woman in a beige tank top (R2). The curly-haired woman closes her eyes with a warm smile. On the right, the afro-haired woman in a beige tank top (R3) smiles widely at the camera while hugging the curly-haired woman from behind. Soft studio lighting highlights their expressions.
elements: R1 places her hand on R2's shoulder
R2 is the central recipient of contact from R1 and R3
R1 smiles toward R2 while touching her shoulder
